notes.title: December Update
notes.notes:
There's a new update for Strange Aeons, so here's brief overview of current state of the game:

 The game at this point is 100% completed and most of the changes now are technical improvements - version v0.5 has improvements for the Windows launcher.
 Strange Aeons now has a price and a release date - it will come out on January 13, 2023 for the price of $11.99 (this will be the third game I release on a Friday the 13th).  


That's it! See you all on release date - be sure to wishlist the game!

notes.title: November Update
notes.notes:
Let me briefly touch upon the things that I've been working on since the last update:
[olist]November Update
This past month I mostly worked on polishing visuals and small improvement, the biggest of which was the redesigned look of keyboard input. Now the text you enter is displayed like this:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37641665/53e550f791f82bd7277aa9143784d2d31c8a2ddc.gif
Gamedev videos
I started making short vertical videos about how the features and plugins created for the game were made. I post these videos on Youtube and TikTok.

I have already made tutorials on the following topics:
Speech-to-textText-to-speechNeural Net AIProcedurally generated musicImaginary languages[/olist]
